row:
Physio Matters is now so much more than just a podcast. After years of bringing you interviews with leading industry experts, Physio Matters has transformed into both an information portal and a community whilst continuing to deliver you a network of podcasts.

Musculoskeletal and Sports Medicine information for those working in physiotherapy, sports therapy, sports rehabilitation, medicine and all divisions of the healthcare industry.

We are on all podcast platforms you can subscribe here: https://physio-matters.com/pm-podcast/
